entities.title: No distribution yet
entities.summary: Builds stay private until release; nothing deploys LodeStar.
entities.purpose: Development and testing on the developer's machine.
entities.deployedBy: Nobody. No workflow deploys any game any more, and LodeStar has no package.json or Worker; exports are made by hand (src/hosting/godot/.dev/runbooks.json).
entities.rollback: Not applicable: nothing is distributed. A local build is replaced by building an earlier commit.
entities.details: Distribution at release is decided in the publish phase (DESIGN § Desktop build), with the credit line create-retro-game requires.
